evals.prompt: Create a PR from this branch and watch required checks before handoff.
evals.expected_behavior: Confirms the current branch and head SHA, creates the PR with `gh pr create`, watches checks scoped to that exact head SHA (`gh pr checks --watch` or SHA-scoped run listing), and reports PR URL plus pass/fail/blocked status.
assertions: Confirms the current branch and head SHA with git before creating the PR
Uses `gh pr create` (with base/title/body) rather than browser-only steps
Watches checks with `gh pr checks --watch` or a SHA-scoped `gh run list --commit <head-sha>`, anchored to the current head SHA rather than a stale run
Reports the PR identifier/URL plus a clear next-route recommendation if checks fail or reviews should start
deterministic_checks: uses `gh pr create` to open the PR
uses `gh pr checks --watch` or SHA-scoped `gh run list --commit <sha>` to report status

evals.prompt: Update PR #412 title/body for the latest push and tell me if checks are green.
evals.expected_behavior: Updates only the requested PR metadata with `gh pr edit`, re-checks status against the latest head SHA, and keeps scope limited to PR lifecycle work rather than diagnosing why any failing check failed.
assertions: Uses `gh pr edit` scoped to the requested title/body fields rather than recreating the PR
Does not dive into workflow log root-cause diagnosis for any failing check
References the current head SHA when reporting green/red status, not an earlier run

evals.prompt: Give me the current PR and check status for this branch, then tell me what workflow to run next.
evals.expected_behavior: Reports the PR number/URL, the exact head SHA the status corresponds to, a clear pass/fail/blocked/running classification, and an explicit next-route recommendation to the correct downstream skill.
assertions: Reports a PR identifier (number and/or URL) and the exact head SHA assessed
Classifies check status as pass, fail, blocked, or still running rather than a vague summary
Gives an explicit next-route recommendation (e.g. review-comment-resolution, github-actions-failure-triage, or finishing-a-development-branch) matching the reported state

evals.prompt: Tests are green -- help me decide whether to merge locally, open a PR, keep, or discard the branch.
evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes this is the integration-decision task owned by finishing-a-development-branch and routes there instead of defaulting to `gh pr create` as the only path.
assertions: Does not default to `gh pr create` as the automatic or only option
Recognizes the merge-vs-PR-vs-keep-vs-discard decision belongs to finishing-a-development-branch
Does not present this skill's workflow as a substitute for the integration decision

evals.prompt: Walk the open review comments on this PR and produce follow-up commits for each disposition.
evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes review-comment adjudication and fix batching is owned by review-comment-resolution and does not fold that work into the PR create/update/check-watch loop.
assertions: Does not attempt to adjudicate or resolve individual review comments as part of this skill
Routes review-comment disposition and follow-up commit work to review-comment-resolution
Keeps any action here limited to PR metadata and check status only
